plan.title: Bulk counter offer to all RFQ vendors

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be configured.
Use an RFQ-only event, matching the case setup.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item for the vendor bids.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors so the bulk action has several vendor bids to target.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Submit a quote from the first invited vendor.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit a quote from a different invited vendor.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Close the RFQ so the QCS contains completed bids and the bulk counter-offer action is available.
Open the comparison grid and verify that the bid data is present.
Open the RFQ Settings action that launches the bulk counter-offer flow.

args.goal: in the open bulk counter-offer flow, select the Price field, enter a valid new counter value, send the counter offer to all vendors, and verify the success tooltip, original-versus-counter highlighting, and a Counter Offer Requested tag above every vendor in the QCS

steps.note: Complete the bulk counter-offer form and observe the UI evidence required by the case.
Assert that both bidding vendors received the counter-offer request tag.
